content_of_post_to_comment: The more I look at the world, the more convinced I become that David Pearce is simply right. We should eliminate suffering as a possible state of matter and build minds that run on gradients of bliss rather than gradients of suffering and underwhelming pleasures. Morality then becomes an engineering problem.
comment: The hardest question may not be whether we can engineer bliss, but whether a mind without suffering can still generate the values we associate with meaning, growth, and agency.
